tasks.description: Research and decide on a payment provider to integrate with the app. This will involve evaluating different options and selecting the one that best fits the needs of the project. The chosen provider should support multiple currencies and have a robust API for integration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of payment providers, when evaluated for features and pricing, then the best provider is selected

tasks.description: Integrate the chosen payment provider's API with the app's backend. This will involve writing code to handle payment processing and communicating with the payment provider's servers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment request, when sent to the payment provider's API, then a successful response is received

tasks.description: Define the different subscription plans and their prices. This will involve working with finance and legal to determine the plan tiers and pricing. The plans should be stored in the database for easy retrieval.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of plan tiers, when stored in the database, then the plans can be retrieved and displayed

tasks.description: Determine how to handle tax for payments and implement the necessary logic. This will involve researching tax laws and regulations and writing code to calculate and apply tax to payments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment amount, when tax is applied, then the correct tax amount is calculated

tasks.description: Determine the refund policy and implement the necessary logic. This will involve researching refund laws and regulations and writing code to handle refunds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refund request, when processed, then the correct refund amount is calculated

tasks.description: Create a user interface for users to enter their payment information and select a subscription plan. This will involve designing and implementing the UI components and integrating them with the backend payment logic.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user, when they navigate to the payment page, then a payment form is displayed

tasks.description: Write code to activate a user's subscription once payment is received. This will involve updating the user's account status and sending a confirmation email.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment confirmation, when received, then the user's subscription is activated

tasks.description: Write unit tests and integration tests to ensure the payment functionality is working correctly. This will involve testing the payment API integration, tax handling, and refund policy.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment test suite, when run, then all tests pass
